request.prompt: A cheerful mid-rise office tower: yellow and white horizontal bands, rounded glass corners, a green roof with a small helipad, a lobby with a big round clock. Stylized cartoon game asset in the spirit of premium Apple Arcade city builders and Pixar-like toy worlds: chunky soft-beveled shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, hand-painted textures, vibrant natural colours, clean readable silhouette from a high three-quarter camera. Single object only on a flat square base no larger than its footprint, no terrain, no people, no text, no logos, neutral lighting without baked shadows. Game-ready economical topology, textured PBR.
